author: IGN
description:
The Master Sword may be the sword important to the story of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, but it’s not the strongest sword in the game. That would be the Biggoron Sword, which is the reward given at the end of the game’s lengthy trading sequence. The same is true of this Switch 2 remake of this iconic title. In this video guide, we’ll go through each step to complete this sequence, from obtaining the Pocket Cucco all the way up to wielding the Biggoron Sword.

description:
Getting off to a strong start in Phantom Blade Zero means having the right weapons for the job. From devastating two-handed swords and fast dual-blade combinations to poison-inflicting daggers and shield-breaking Phantom Edges, there are plenty of powerful options to find during the early game.

In this guide, we're breaking down the best early weapons in Phantom Blade Zero, including where to find them, what makes them so effective, and which upgrades you should prioritize. We'll cover the Sanguine weapon set, Jagged Steel, Scarlet Wraithblade, White Serpent & Crimson Viper, and the best Phantom Edges to keep equipped as you progress.

#IGN #Gaming
title: The BEST Early Weapons in Phantom Blade Zero

author: IGN
description: Jennifer Hale and Mark Meer voiced Commander Shepard throughout the series' history and have a strong presence in the Mass Effect community. They've lent their support to the movement to save Mass Effect and discuss what that can look like from a practical perspective in our interview. They talk about BioWare's closure, how much the studio meant to them, and the problem with prioritizing profit over in the time that publisher EA has owned BioWare and the Mass Effect IP. They also look back at their favorite moments from the game's history and share their thoughts on a possible future for the franchise, including the planned Amazon TV series.
title: Is There a Possible Future for Mass Effect? Jennifer Hale and Mark Meer Interview

description:
Check out the latest trailer for Blackwood to see what to expect with the Contracts Update, which brings new content to Act 1, alongside gameplay improvements, new weapons, additional music, and fixes to the action game. The new contracts introduce a varied set of challenges, including a wave-based shooter, a drifting trial, and a sniper mission. 

Blackwood Act 1 is available now on Steam, with Act and Act 3 launching in 2027. The Contracts Update for Blackwood is available now.

author: IGN
description:
Queen's Domain impressions by Michael Higham, played on PC (also available on PS5, Xbox, and Switch 2)

"I'm a sucker for a good throwback to the early polygonal 32-bit era – Mouthwashing, Signalis, Crow Country, and Boltgun 2 are some recent favorites that come to mind. The latest one I've locked in on is Queen's Domain, a fantasy RPG that's as if an Elder Scrolls game was made for the PlayStation 1. Actually, it's explicitly inspired by FromSoftware's pre-Dark Souls series King's Field, where slow, deliberate first-person combat and exploration complemented punishing difficulty (which would later become FromSoft's signature, of course). But as much as Queen's Domain draws clear inspiration or shares similarities, it's a singular experience in 2026 that, from what I've played so far, wields the intended friction of an old-school game wonderfully."
title: Want a New Elder Scrolls? Play Queen's Domain, the Old-School RPG Inspired by King's Field
